correctness.rationale: The face criterion follows from explicit four-vertex path case analysis, and the contractible-join union has graph intersections; Mayer–Vietoris and relative 2-cell attachments give torsion-free H2 and no higher homology. The full two-skeleton gives pi1=0; Euler determines rank; Hurewicz plus homology Whitehead yields an integral sphere wedge. The Lefschetz calculation gives a complete rational character and direct module sum. Included exact checkers independently confirm 64 finite face/homology cases and 123 group character cases.
